skill_name: Compare the benefits of a plant-based diet versus eating meat.
workflow: A plant-based diet provides numerous health benefits. Plant-based diets emphasize whole foods such as fruits, vegetables, whole grains, nuts and legumes that are rich in vitamins, minerals and fiber and are low in saturated fat. Plant-based diets are naturally low in cholesterol and saturated fat, and are associated with a reduced risk of heart disease and other chronic conditions such as hypertension and diabetes. Additionally, plant-based diets are a more sustainable way to meet dietary needs
